# F186: nice-only builds and the machine-build baton

Effective 2026-11-11, Jordan's ruling at governance `f078301c`, `.harness/government/handover/prime-preferences.md:9`, supersedes plan 208 ac-0010 and the plan 209/F63 automatic compile/run split. Do not revive the older performance instructions that put compilation under `taskpolicy -b`.

- Run local pij cargo builds/tests under **nice -n 19 only**. `shared-build` preserves the target lock, disk floor, source freshness, default four cargo jobs/test threads, `CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0`, status propagation and process-group draining. Existing caller overrides remain; the default is not an absolute global four-process limit.
- Ordinary tests now use one cargo invocation instead of compile-only plus run. That does not mean tests formerly executed twice. Doc tests already had one nice-only invocation. Removal of background QoS allows performance-core scheduling and unthrottled I/O, but nice is not core affinity or a measured speedup.
- A newer same-day operational ruling, delivered by pm-001 at 10:25, requires **one heavy run machine-wide across all projects, until further notice**. Obtain the `machine-build` baton before any local cargo build/check/test/clippy, full Vitest/tsc/pnpm build or docker build; keeper is `pij-outstanding-silkworm`. Continue using nice 19.

```text
pij orchestration baton request machine-build --purpose 'pij-fleet: <what>'
# Wait for the grant. Run nothing heavy merely because the request was accepted.
pij orchestration baton return machine-build --lease-id <granted lease> --evidence '<done>'
```

Return the baton immediately after the run. The shared target's artifact lock and the machine-wide baton solve different problems; possession of one never implies the other. A run already in flight may finish, but start no queued run without a grant. Read the latest prime ruling before resuming after a compact; this machine-wide restriction is explicitly until further notice.

Prefer CI proof. #228's frozen head `b0259b1987d3f829e5494cefa9e366d07404544b` has CI run `42929038558`: all 19 shared-build cases passed, including actual nice-19 observation with a fake taskpolicy present at both PATH and the retired seam. No local heavy command was needed for the review.
